measurements.name: East Adriatic Current
measurements.range_interpretation: Author-reported local descriptor. No statistical error, full-current inference or annual range supplied.
measurements.geographic_scope: Primosten southwestward cross-section over the Middle Adriatic Pit, between Blitvenica and Jabuka; first approximately 10 km from the eastern coast.
measurements.layer: Vessel ADCP sampled 10-70 m in 4 m bins; author does not specify paired edges at a fixed depth. Figure 1 arrows represent 10 m despite surface placement.
measurements.time_convention: C1 cruise 24-28 May 2017; plotted section28 May 2017. Numeric prose extent belongs to C1; exact width occupation day unresolved. C2 June 2018 is not a second numeric width.
measurements.boundary_rule: Author-described limit of coastal inflow belonging to EAC; no numerical velocity threshold, coastline-edge reconstruction or perpendicular correction extracted.
measurements.section_orientation: Author cross-section descriptor; no independent perpendicular correction or paired edge extraction.
measurements.source_citation: Pasaric, Z., H. Mihanovic and M. Orlic (2019), Spatial variability of pycnocline in the springtime East Adriatic, Rapp. Comm. int. Mer Medit. 42, p38. Complete congress abstract volume retained; only the one-page authored abstract reviewed.
measurements.source_locator: CIESM volume 42 (2019), printed p38 / PDF 38, methods and final current paragraph; Figure 1 caption.
measurements.extraction_method: Numerical prose descriptor transcribed from reviewed original. Source figures inspected for context only; no curve or velocity boundaries digitized.
measurements.source_quality_note: Author conference abstract and figure inspected; one local reported extent, no raw ADCP data or thresholded boundary pair. Exact width day and width at each sampled depth not independently resolved.
remaining_gates: Independent review of source naming, metric and local support before canonical admission.
Acquire raw sections and paired velocity edges for any full width; obtain compatible repeats before annual ranges.

original_regional_context.display_aria_label: East Adriatic Current: about 10 km coastal inflow extent during 24-28 May 2017 near Primosten. Local ADCP description, not whole-current or annual width.
original_regional_context.display_caption: C1, 24-28 May 2017: inflow identified as part of EAC was confined to roughly the first 10 km offshore. This is a local coastal extent, with exact width occupation day unresolved.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: ADCP sampled 10-70 m; plotted surface arrows represent 10 m. The 20 km upwelling/pycnocline extent is a different object. C2 supplies no numeric EAC width, so no annual or seasonal range is inferred.
original_regional_context.quality_note: Author conference abstract and figure inspected; one local reported extent, no raw ADCP data or thresholded boundary pair. Exact width day and width at each sampled depth not independently resolved.
